브라우저는 새 창이 열리는 것을 막을 때가 있습니다. 이를 팝업 차단이라: Browsers sometimes stop a new window from opening. This is called pop-up blocking. Allow pop-ups for this site once and the window will open from then on.
Press the pop-up blocked icon that appeared at the right end of the address bar.
Choose the option that contains "Always allow", then press "Done".
Go back to the VPyLab screen and press the same button again.
아이패드와 아이폰에서는 설정 앱의 Safari 항목에서 \"팝업 차단\": On an iPad or iPhone, turn off "Block Pop-ups" under Safari in the Settings app.
그 밖의 브라우저는 설정 위치가 다릅니다. 찾기 어려우면 선생님께 도움을: Other browsers keep this setting in a different place. If you cannot find it, ask your teacher for help.
\"구글 계정으로 로그인\"을 누르면 구글 창이 따로 열립니다. 그 창에: Pressing "Sign in with Google" opens a separate Google window. In that window, choose the Google account you will save with.
권한을 묻는 화면에서 \"Google Drive 파일\"이 적힌 줄의 체: On the screen that asks for permission, the box on the line that says "Google Drive files" starts empty. Tick it yourself. If you do not tick it, nothing is saved.
\"계속\"을 누르면 구글 창이 닫히고 VPyLab 화면으로 돌아와 저장: Press "Continue" and the Google window closes. You return to the VPyLab screen and the save carries on.
If you cannot see the new window, it may be hidden behind another window. If you cannot find it, the browser may have blocked it. See "If the window does not open" below.
버튼을 누르면 구글 창이 따로 열려. 놀라지 말고 아래 순서대로 하면 저: Pressing the button opens a separate Google window. Don't worry, follow the steps below and your work gets saved.
Press "Ask for Drive access again" and the Google window opens again.
\"Google Drive 파일\"이 적힌 줄의 빈 체크 상자를 눌러 체: Tick the empty box on the line that says "Google Drive files".
Press "Continue" and the save you started carries on.
\"다시 승인\"을 누르면 구글 창이 잠깐 열렸다가 스스로 닫힙니다. 그: Press "Approve again" and the Google window opens for a moment and closes by itself. The save you started then carries on.
구글 창이 계정을 물으면 이 창 위쪽에 표시된 계정과 같은 계정을 고릅니: If the Google window asks for an account, choose the same account shown at the top of this window. If you choose a different account, nothing is saved.
고장이 아니야. 구글 연결은 약 1시간마다 다시 승인받으니까 천천히 해도: Nothing is broken. The Google connection is approved again about every 1 hour, so take your time.
같은 파일을 다른 탭이나 다른 기기에서 먼저 저장했을 때 이 안내가 나타: You see this when the same file was saved first from another tab or another device. Until you choose a button, both your code and the file in Drive stay as they are.
내 코드를 사본으로 저장 버튼을 고르면 내 코드가 파일 이름 끝에 \"(: This saves your code as a new file whose name ends with "(사본)", which means "copy". The original file in Drive does not change. Both files are kept.
드라이브 내용 불러오기 버튼을 고르면 편집기의 코드가 드라이브에 저장된: This replaces the code in the editor with what is saved in Drive. The changes you just made are lost.
This replaces the file in Drive with your code. What was saved first disappears from the file, and you can still find it in the version history in Google Drive.
어느 쪽이 맞는지 모르겠으면 사본으로 저장하면 돼. 두 파일이 모두 남으: Not sure which one is right? Save a copy. Both files are kept, so you can open them later and compare.
구글 로그인이나 드라이브 저장을 사용할 수 없어도 지금 코드를 파일로 보: Even if you cannot use Google sign-in or Drive saving, you can keep your current code as a file. Close this window and follow the steps below.
Press "Tools" at the top of the Create screen.
\"HTML 내려받기\"를 누르면 작품이 파일로 컴퓨터에 저장됩니다. 이: Press "Download HTML" and your work is saved to the computer as a file. The file also contains your code.
이어서 작업할 때는 \"도구\"의 \"파일 열기 (.py, .html)\: To carry on later, choose that file from "Open file (.py, .html)" under "Tools".
\"GitHub 연결\"을 누르면 GitHub 창이 따로 열립니다. 로그: Pressing "Connect GitHub" opens a separate GitHub window. If a sign-in screen comes first, sign in with your GitHub username and password.
초록색 \"Authorize vpylab\" 버튼을 누릅니다. 그 위에: Press the green "Authorize vpylab" button. The line above it, "Public repositories and repository invites", means permission to work with public repositories and repository invitations.
GitHub 창이 스스로 닫히고 VPyLab 화면에 내 프로젝트 목록이: The GitHub window closes by itself and your project list appears on the VPyLab screen.
GitHub 계정은 13세 이상만 만들 수 있습니다. github.com: Only people aged 13 or older can make a GitHub account. Sign up at github.com first, then press "Connect GitHub" again.
계정을 만들 수 없으면 구글 드라이브 저장과 공유 링크로 작품을 보관하고: If you cannot make an account, you can still keep and send your work with Google Drive saving and share links.
전에 승인한 적이 있으면 GitHub 창이 열렸다가 바로 닫힐 수 있습니: If you have approved before, the GitHub window may open and close right away. Nothing is broken. The connection is done.
버튼을 누르면 GitHub 창이 따로 열려. 그 창에서 초록색 버튼 하나: Pressing the button opens a separate GitHub window. Press the one green button there and you are connected.
\"다시 연결\"을 누르면 GitHub 창이 열립니다. 초록색 \"Aut: Press "Reconnect" and the GitHub window opens. If you see the green "Authorize vpylab" button, press it. If the window closes right away without the button, the connection is done.
프로젝트 하나가 GitHub의 공개 저장소 하나로 만들어집니다. 누구나: Each project is made as one public repository on GitHub. Anyone can see the code, so do not write personal information such as your name or phone number in it.
Creating it takes about 20 seconds. Do not close this window until it finishes.
다 만들어지면 \"게시 주소\"가 생깁니다. 이 주소를 열면 누구나 작품: When it is done, a "Published page" address appears. Anyone who opens it can run your work. The address may take 1 to 2 minutes to start working.
팀원에게 GitHub 아이디를 물어봅니다. 이메일 주소가 아니라 GitH: Ask your team member for their GitHub username. It is the name they use on GitHub, not an email address.
\"초대할 GitHub 아이디\" 칸에 아이디를 입력하고 \"초대\"를: Type the username in the "GitHub username to invite" box and press "Invite".
팀원은 자기 컴퓨터에서 \"팀 프로젝트\" 창을 열고 \"받은 초대\"에: On their own computer, your team member opens the "Team projects" window and presses "Accept" under "Invitations received".
팀원이 수락한 뒤 \"목록 새로 고침\"을 누르면 팀원 목록에 팀원의 아: After they accept, press "Refresh list" and their username appears in the team member list. From then on they can save to this project too.
\"수락\"을 누르면 그 프로젝트가 \"내 프로젝트\" 목록에 나타납니다: Press "Accept" and the project appears in the "My projects" list. Press the project in the list to open it.
그래도 없으면, 초대한 친구가 입력한 아이디가 이 창 위쪽에 표시된 내: If it is still missing, check with the friend who invited you that the username they typed matches your GitHub username shown at the top of this window.
최신 코드 가져오기 버튼을 고르면 편집기의 코드가 팀원이 저장한 최신 코: This replaces the code in the editor with the latest code your team member saved. Your changes are lost, so copy the parts you want to keep first.
This makes your code the latest code of the project. What your team member saved is no longer in the latest code, but it stays in the save history on GitHub.
Before you choose, it helps to ask your team member what they changed.
컴퓨터실처럼 여러 사람이 사용하는 컴퓨터에서는 사용을 마칠 때 아래 순서: On a computer that many people use, such as in a computer lab, tidy up in the order below when you finish. If you do not, the next person may be able to see your account and code.
Press "Save" and check that your work is saved.
\"내 드라이브\" 버튼을 눌러 창을 엽니다. 파일을 열어 두었으면 이: Press the "My Drive" button to open its window. If a file is open, this button shows the file name instead. In the window, press "Sign out", and when you are asked whether to delete the drafts left in this browser as well, press "OK".
로그아웃한 뒤 나타나는 \"공용 컴퓨터에서는 구글 계정에서도 로그아웃하십: After signing out, press the link "On a shared computer, also sign out of your Google account." and sign out of your Google account too.
If you connected GitHub, press the "Team projects" button to open its window. If a project is open, this button shows the project title instead. In the window, press "Disconnect GitHub", then use the link that appears to sign out of GitHub too.
도구 메뉴의 \"초기 코드로 돌아가기\"를 눌러 편집기에 남은 코드를 지: Press "Back to starting code" in the Tools menu to clear the code left in the editor.
